versions.content: { DRAFT } If CanNmPnShutdownMessageRetransmissionDuration is configured and transmission of a P N shutdown message is requested (refer to [SWS_CanNm_00506] ) for the first time, then the corresponding retransmission timer for PN shutdown messages shall be started with CanNmPnShutdownMessageRetransmissionDuration on all affe cted NM - channels.
